title: Six weeks to the exam

exam.shape: Theory 20 · Wiring & Protection (100–285) 20 · Wiring Methods (300–398) 12 · Equipment (400–490) 6 · Special Occupancies 4 · Special Equipment 2 · Communications (700–830) 6
exam.source: PSI Maryland Master and Journeyperson Electrician bulletin, read 2026-11-07

ready: Ready is both benchmarks (Dec 6 and Dec 13, in the exam's shape) at 80% or better. Both 74–79: sit it anyway and taper. Either under 72: move the date.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.theme: Box fill, dwelling loads, Art 230, cables and raceways

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.theme: Chapter 9 fill, voltage drop, conductor sizing

weeks.label: Exam week
weeks.theme: Taper. Sit it when PSI gives the date.

weeks.label: Holding
weeks.theme: Only if the date comes later: a sim a Sunday, an hour a night

days.title: Restart night
steps: Sim Exams book, Ch 2 How to Use the NEC (printed p7–8). Read it once, 15 min.
Sim Exams book, Ch 4 test-taking tips (printed p59–62). 5 min.
Check the code book against PSI's rules: tabs must be permanent plastic (Avery Swift Tabs or Redi-Tag), not Post-it flags; highlighter is fine, pen anywhere in the book is not; nothing loose inside.
days.note: Light night. Sim A tomorrow, 4 hours, start by 9 am.

days.title: Sim #1 · baseline
days.note: Mike's Exam A, 100 questions, 4 hours. Whatever the score, it is the starting line. On paper, note the clock at every tenth question: your real pace, from day one.
steps: Start by 9 am. Four hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Art 250 Part I · the effective ground-fault current path

video.say: Mike opens 250: scope, 250.4(A)(1)–(5) and (B), what grounding is for

steps: Highlight 250.4 and 250.6 in the 2020 book as he reads them: blue over the heading, yellow after shall, red highlighter under the numbers. Highlighter only, never pen.

days.title: Art 250 Part I · objectionable current, connections
steps: Finish highlighting Part I.

days.title: Art 250 Part II · service grounding, bonding jumpers, separately derived systems

video.say: 250.24: where the grounded conductor lands and why nowhere else
250.32: a second building on a feeder

steps: Work five supply-side bonding jumper sizes from Table 250.102(C)(1). Highlight 250.24(A)(1), (A)(5), (B), (C); 250.28(D); 250.30(A); 250.32(A), (B)(1).
The generator video (250.30 for generators, 19 min) is for the drive, not tonight.

days.title: Art 250 Part III · electrodes and the grounding electrode conductor

video.say: 250.50 to 250.70: every electrode, the rod rules, 250.64, Table 250.66

steps: Work ten Table 250.66 problems, with the 6 AWG rod cap and the 4 AWG concrete-encased cap. Highlight 250.52(A), 250.53(A), 250.64, 250.66, 250.68.

days.title: Art 250 Parts IV–V · enclosures, bonding at the service, bonding jumper sizing

video.say: 250.80 to 250.106: service bonding, intersystem bonding, 250.102, piping and structural metal

steps: Video runs long tonight (74 min): skip the pages, keep the problems. Five bonding jumper sizes, supply side by 250.102(C)(1) and load side by 250.122. Highlight 250.92(B), 250.94, 250.97, 250.102(C), (D), 250.104(A), (B), (C).

days.title: Art 250 Parts VI–VII · equipment grounding conductors and their connections

video.say: 250.109 to 250.148: what counts as an EGC, Table 250.122, receptacles, boxes

steps: Work ten Table 250.122 problems, including the proportional upsizing in (B). 250.140 in your 2020 book is the main paragraph and its exception, not an (A). Then redo every 250 miss from Sim #1 in the Missed questions fold.

days.title: Sim #2 · Maryland shape
days.note: 70 questions in PSI Maryland's own proportions, 3½ hours. 49 right passes the real one. The first 20 are theory: under 15 of them means theory joins every Saturday from here.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Box fill · 314.16

video.say: Unit 2 Part A: Table 314.16(A), the volume rules of 314.16(B), worked examples

steps: Work ten box-fill problems with mixed sizes, a device yoke and an EGC. Highlight 314.16(A) and (B)(1)–(5).

days.title: Pull and junction boxes · 314.28

video.say: Unit 2 Part B: 8× straight, 6× plus the rest for angle and U pulls

steps: Work six pull-box problems: two straight, two angle, two with several raceways on one wall. Highlight 314.28(A)(1)–(3).

days.title: Dwelling load · standard and optional, first half
steps: Work example 6.13 start to finish on paper before Mike finishes it. In the 2020 book the lighting load is 220.12 and the demand table is Table 220.42; pencil those in the Exam Prep margin.

days.title: Dwelling load · second half, neutral

video.say: Unit 6, second half: ranges, dryers, AC vs heat, 310.12, the neutral

steps: Work the same house both ways, standard and optional, and compare the service sizes. Highlight 220.52–220.61 and 220.82.

days.title: Article 230 · services

pages.what: Art 230, no video tonight: read it with the book open

steps: 230.2 number of services, 230.6 outside a building, 230.9 clearances, 230.24 overhead clearances, 230.42 sizing, 230.43 wiring methods, 230.70–230.72 the disconnect, 230.79 ratings, 230.85 emergency disconnect, 230.90 overload protection.
Highlight the whole article from its ★ list. Art 230 is three of the twenty Wiring & Protection questions.

days.title: Cables and raceways · 334, 358 and their neighbours
steps: Highlight 334, 358 from their ★ lists; then read and highlight 320, 330, 344, 352 from theirs: uses permitted and not permitted, support spacing, bends. Twelve of the seventy are wiring methods, and they are almost all lookups.

days.title: Sim #3
days.note: Mike's Exam B, 100 questions, 4 hours: the one code-wide stress test. Heavier on Chapters 5–8 than Maryland is.
steps: Start by 9 am. Four hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Raceway fill · Chapter 9, first half

video.say: Unit 1, first half: Tables 1, 4, 5 and Annex C

steps: Work eight fills: four straight from Annex C, four with mixed sizes through Tables 4 and 5. Note 7: round up at 0.8. Note 4: nipples at 60%.

days.title: Raceway fill · second half, wireways, cables
steps: Highlight the notes to Ch 9 Table 1 and the heads of Tables 4, 5 and 8; tab Annex C by raceway type (permanent tabs). Wireways are 20% (376.22).

days.title: Voltage drop · the formula

video.say: Unit 5 whole: circular mils, Table 8, 2KID/CM and the three-phase 1.732

steps: Work six: three single-phase, three three-phase, in volts and in percent. 3% and 5% are informational notes under 210.19 and 215.2.

days.title: Voltage drop · sizing the conductor; Art 250 again (Thanksgiving, 60 min)
steps: CM = 2 × K × I × D ÷ VD, then up to the next Table 8 size. Distance is one way. Work four.
Then redo every miss in the Missed questions fold, cold. Tonight's twenty are Art 250: two weeks on, does it hold?

days.title: Conductor sizing · insulation, terminals, ampacity

video.say: Unit 3, first half: 110.14(C), 240.4, Table 310.16, correction and adjustment

pages.what: Unit 3 Parts A and B to 3.9

steps: Work eight: pick from the 75°C column, then check against the corrected 90°C ampacity. In the 2020 book the insulation table is Table 310.4(A).

days.title: Conductor sizing · branch circuits, feeders, taps

video.say: Unit 3, second half: 210.19, 210.20, 215.2, 215.3, the tap rules of 240.21(B)

days.title: Sim #4 · Maryland shape
days.note: 70 questions, 3½ hours, Maryland's proportions, none seen before.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Article 240 · overcurrent protection
steps: Memorize 240.6(A). Highlight the whole article from its ★ list; 240.21(B) and (C), 240.24 first.

days.title: Article 310 · conductors for general wiring
steps: Highlight from the ★ list: 310.10, 310.12 and Table 310.12(A), 310.15(B), (C), (E), Table 310.16.

days.title: Motors · FLC, conductors, the breaker
steps: Work four complete motor circuits: conductor, overload, breaker, feeder (430.24, 430.62).

days.title: Motors · overloads, AC; Article 430 itself
steps: Highlight Art 430 from its ★ list; tab Table 430.52 and the FLC tables.

days.title: Appliances, heating, air conditioning · 422, 424, 440
steps: Highlight 422, 424, 440 from their ★ lists: 422.10, 422.11, 422.16 cords, 422.31 disconnects, 424.3, 440.4(B), 440.14. One transformer problem by Table 450.3(B) and that is enough transformers.

days.title: Rework 240 / 310 / 430; finish the highlighting
steps: Redo every 240, 310, 430, 440 miss in the Missed questions fold, cold.
Any ★ list on this page still open (225, 408, 410 included): close it tonight.
Sim Exams book Ch 4 tips once more (printed p59–62). Tomorrow is benchmark 1.

days.title: Sim #5 · benchmark 1
days.note: Benchmark 1, in the exam's shape. 80 or better (56 of 70): on track. 74–79: sit it and taper. Under 72 (50): this score alone moves the date, today, while a reschedule is still free.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: All sim misses, cold
days.what: Every miss from Sims #1–#5. Redo them below without looking at the old answer; anything missed twice is red and comes back Saturday.
steps: Lookup drill: shut the book, then find the section of each sim miss in under 60 seconds. Time every one.

days.title: Article 250 misses
days.what: Every 250 miss. For each, read the whole section in the 2020 book, not just the line.
steps: Lookup drill: the 250 sections in the notebook, 60 seconds each, then Table 250.66 and Table 250.122 blind.

days.title: 220 and 314 misses
days.what: Every load-calc and box-fill miss. Then Exam Prep 6.13 and 6.2 once more, on paper.
steps: Lookup drill: Table 220.55 and its notes, Table 220.54, Table 220.42, 314.16(B), 314.28(A), timed.

days.title: Chapter 9, voltage drop and 310 misses
days.what: Every conduit-fill, voltage-drop and ampacity miss. Two fresh fills, two fresh drops, two corrections with both factors.
steps: Lookup drill: Ch 9 Tables 1, 4, 5, 8, Annex C, Table 310.16, 310.15(B)(1), 310.15(C)(1), blind and timed.

days.title: 240, 430, 440 misses
days.what: Every overcurrent, motor and AC miss. One full motor circuit, end to end.

days.title: Twice-missed, and theory
days.what: Everything red. Then the Theory questions below: 20 of the 70 are theory, the biggest block on the exam.
steps: Lookup drill: twenty random index words from the 2020 book, 60 seconds each.

days.title: Sim #6 · benchmark 2
days.note: Benchmark 2, same shape. Both benchmarks 80 or better: sit it. Both 74–79: sit it; Mike's questions run harder than PSI's. Either under 72: the holding weeks below, and the date moves.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: 30 min lookup drill from the notebook, then 20 timed questions from any sim you have not re-sat. No new material.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Same. Rework only what is still red in the Missed questions fold.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Same. Call PSI once: calculator rules (the bulletin does not say), arrival time, what ID they want. Use that calculator on every quiz from today.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Lookup drill only. Pack: the 2020 NEC, tabbed with permanent plastic tabs only (no Post-it flags, no paper inserts, nothing written in it, nothing loose), two forms of ID with the name on the application, the PSI confirmation.

days.title: Night before
steps: Sim Exams book Ch 4 (printed p59–62). Nothing else. No swim in the morning, or a short easy one done two hours before the slot. In bed early.

days.title: Exam day
steps: Breakfast. Arrive 30 minutes early. Read every question twice before touching the book. Flag the long ones and come back. 49 right is a pass.

days.title: Holding sim
days.note: Only if PSI has not given you a date yet. Same conditions, same clock.
steps: Start by 9 am. Four hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.
Checkpoints: at 60 min you are past Q20; at 120 min past Q40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.
Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook and Saturday redoes them.

days.title: Holding week · one hour
days.what: Until PSI gives a date: every miss still red, then twenty timed questions. No new material; the book does not get thicker.
steps: Lookup drill: ten sections from the notebook, blind, 60 seconds each.
